curation.notes: Compared 2026-10-08 (norms:compare exit 1). Both extractors read the men's mean as printed, +1.17 (page image p. 474, PDF p. 5: mean 1.17, SD 1.9, range -2 to 4 mm, with no minus before 1.17) and both flagged that the same sentence places BO about 1 mm ahead of AO. Settled by OWNER RULING 7 Oct: men -1.17, SD 1.9, printed range not stored; women -0.10 +- 1.77 (range -4.5 to 1.5) as printed - all re-read from the image (the reprint prints the minus signs on -0.10, -2, -4.5 and the Class III examples). Differences settled: citation.doi a=10.1067/... b=10.1016/... -> 10.1016/S0889-5406(03)00540-7, the publisher's DOI (jacobson-1975.html); the reprint PDF prints doi:10.1067/S0889-5406(03)00540-7 (caveat). Source wording on both rows (prose). Selection a='ideal-aesthetic' b='class-I' -> class-I (chosen for excellent occlusion, p. 474; facial balance not stated). PMID 1054214 from the owner ruling (abstract). Scale not-stated. The old caveat 'reprint text lost its minus signs' is wrong and not carried (merge notes).

caveats: Read from the Classic Article reprint, Am J Orthod Dentofacial Orthop 2003;124:470-9 (first published Am J Orthod, February 1975;67:125-38). The reprint PDF prints doi:10.1067/S0889-5406(03)00540-7; the publisher page gives 10.1016/S0889-5406(03)00540-7 (the reprint's DOI). The citation's doi is the 1975 original's, 10.1016/0002-9416(75)90065-2, as SOURCES.md gives it (final review M-1, 12 Oct; until then the reprint DOI was stored).

Men's mean: printed '1.17' without a sign (p. 474), but the same sentence places BO about 1 mm ahead of AO, the summary says the same, and by his own rule (p. 474) BO forward of AO is negative. Owner ruling 7 Oct: stored as -1.17 (SD 1.9); the printed range (-2 to 4 mm) fits the unsigned figure, not the ruling, so it is not stored.
Women: -0.10 mm, SD 1.77, range -4.5 to 1.5 as printed (the text says AO and BO usually fell together).
Sample: 21 adult men and 25 adult women chosen for excellent occlusion (p. 474). Ages, ethnicity, film scale and head position are not stated. The values are in running text, not a table.
Sign (p. 474): BO behind AO is a positive reading (Class II), BO ahead of AO negative (Class III) - the catalogue's sign for #13.
